description: This file is a controller class in a Spring-based Java web application. It defines REST API endpoints for managing 'Customer' entities, including operations such as retrieving all customers, adding a new customer, retrieving, updating, and deleting customers by their customer number.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: REST controller for customer management operations, providing endpoints for CRUD operations related to Customer entities.

methods.name: getAllCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of all customers.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new customer, accepting customer details in the request body.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific customer identified by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing customer's information.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a customer by customer number.
